notes.text: What changed in version 2.0.1, the release this site is built from. The Nintendo DS port is on 2.0.1 too.

items: The Martyr is a real final boss now: 340, 525 and 550 health across his three phases, and you get 200 health for the last one. Lose a phase and the summary points you to special ammo and Armageddon
UFO hunts get tougher as you go, from 8 to 24 health; co-op saucers have 24, 30, 40 and 45, and the Mothership has 30
The full-size TERMINAL TANKS logo shows on the main menu on most screens, and the game now colours the whole window, edges included
Mission 49 is BROTHERS IN ARMS, rock-paper-scissors says YOU WIN!, and the shop's item panel is cleaner
Under the hood the game is now a proper Python package, with a player's guide, developer docs and automated tests. It plays exactly as before, and every save carries over
The story's last chapter: once all ten Terminal Ticket bosses fall, the Martyr's Arcane Time Machine opens in the shop for a three-phase duel across Ember Sanctum, Tempest Spires and Astral Rift
Defeating the Martyr hands over his relics: six ancient tanks, five ancient ammo types, three sanctum maps, six home screens and the ASTRAL paint
Martyr's Blessing: the Martyr's last power in a single shell. One direct hit judges the whole battlefield. Earned only by beating the Martyr
Eleven animated paints for any tank and its shells, from Prismatic and Void to Molten, Chrome, Aurora, Circuit, Ocean, Synthwave, Toxic and Gilded
A second premium set: ten tanks, ten ammo types, ten battlefields and ten home screens
A soundtrack of 277 songs composed and synthesized by the game itself, with a Jukebox, a 3-band EQ and a spectrum analyser
Up to three profiles, story whispers, a tutorial and an advanced practice range, and the Workshop HOVER upgrade
122 tanks and 121 ammo types in the menus, 147 maps and 100 home screens in all. Save format 5: existing saves carry over
notes.title: The last chapter
The big expansion
items: Far more to unlock: 107 tank designs, 107 ammo types, 79 home screens and 129 maps in all
A new premium tier at the top of the shop, with five extra tanks and five extra ammo types
The Workshop: build and save your own tanks from 129 parts and 24 accent colors
Terminal Tickets: ten boss battles, each with its own tank, map and ammo
Two-player and LAN matches can use a special attack: skip two turns, then your next shot deals 3 damage
Two-player and LAN matches can be played on a map you choose, and you can leave a match from a clear prompt
The Mothership is shielded until both of its drones are destroyed
Glass Cannon levels now give you 2 HP instead of 1
The shop scrolls, so every row is reachable on small terminals
Save format 5. Existing saves, wallets and unlocks carry over.
